Preserve exact character identity, body proportions, white-grey fur pattern and fine pixel-art style, modest ears, cyan irises only inside eyes, clean plain closed mouth, upright broad muscular torso, brown ragged shorts, short bushy tail, large clawed hands and digitigrade feet. Frame7: left knee/foot passes the right support leg, arms cross neutral. Frame8: left leg reaches forward ready to return smoothly to frame1. Natural walk, modest bent knees and relaxed counter-swing arms; no running or hopping. Keep two legs and two arms, no merged feet. Preserve anatomy and clean recognizable silhouette. Add restrained tail counter-sway and only a small shoulder/hip bob, never change tail size or fur pattern. No extraneous motion or reorientation. Maintain stable head shape and eyes throughout. Character must not shrink/grow or change clothing between frames. True transparent alpha background, no floor/shadows, NO labels/numbers/gridlines. Generous margins, no anatomy crossing cell boundaries. Crisp detailed pixel art with consistent small square clusters and palette, no smooth painting. Requested image 2560x1600, cells640x800; prioritize correct eight-pose sequential gait and identical scale. Frame5 MUST reverse which leg is leading compared with frame1. For front/back views, the foot visibly closer to the viewer switches between left and right halves of the body over the cycle. Arms must alternate with those legs. The image must show visible successive walking motion, not mostly identical standing poses.
